parameters.name: DIRECT
parameters.help: Normally use FORWARD, but you can also remove (INVERSE) previously applied NMO.

choices.label: FORWARD
choices.help: Apply NMO... this is the normal application mode.

parameters.name: STR_MUTE
parameters.help: Any sample stretched more than this percentage will be automatically muted (enter 0.0 to disable).

parameters.name: DO_STAT
parameters.prompt: Apply any remaining static during NMO?
parameters.help: If 'Yes', accumulated NA_STAT header word statics (such as the floating datum static) will be applied during NMO.

parameters.name: NMO_APLD
parameters.prompt: Disable check for previously applied NMO?
parameters.help: Normally, you will not want to apply NMO twice, but some exceptions may exist.

parameters.name: IDIP_VEL
parameters.help: Select 'Yes' if applying 3D NMO dip velocity correction.

parameters.name: IBIN_CTR
parameters.help: User may decide if the bin center corrections are to be applied as part of the 3D dip/velocity NMO.

parameters.name: IPARTIAL
parameters.help: You may correct the trace to something other than zero offset for processes that require apparent constant offset.

parameters.name: PART_HDR
parameters.prompt: Header entry with desired non-zero offset
parameters.help: Use MB1 to select a header entry from the headers menu that contains the desired non-zero offset.

parameters.name: LONGOFFS
parameters.help: Choose desired method for long-offset correction.

choices.label: NONE
choices.help: Apply only two term NMO (normal application).

choices.label: CASTLE
choices.help: Apply Castle's shifted hyperbola (slow, least accurate).

choices.label: TSVANKIN
choices.help: Apply Tsvankin and Thomsen's third term (slow, most accurate).

parameters.name: OVERLAY1
parameters.help: After initial overlay processing this is toggled to prevent repetition

parameters.name: LONGOFFS2
parameters.help: Choose desired method for long-offset correction.

choices.label: NONE
choices.help: Apply only two term NMO (normal application).

choices.label: CASTLE
choices.help: Apply Castle's shifted hyperbola (slow, least accurate).

choices.label: HARLAN
choices.help: Apply Harlan's anisotropic third term (slower, good accuracy).

choices.label: TSVANKIN
choices.help: Apply Tsvankin and Thomsen's third term (slowest, most accurate).

choices.label: Variable
choices.help: ETA is retrieved from a table

parameters.name: ETA
parameters.help: Value of zero means no anisotropy correction. Normally nonnegative and less than 0.1

parameters.name: vel_option
parameters.help: Select 'Yes' if there is an appropriate NMO stacking velocity function in the database as a parameter file.

parameters.name: VELNAME
parameters.help: Use Mouse Button 1 to select a velocity function parameter file from the parameter file menu.

parameters.name: VELFIELD
parameters.help: Use Mouse Button 1 to edit/define normal moveout velocity functions. (SEE EDITOR FOR EXAMPLES.)
